source: User-provided nine complete decks; verified against Scryfall card records
caveat: Mechanics are automated keyword/text classifications; legacy supported/partial/manual labels do NOT establish correctness for every card ability. AuditedEffect records are scoped and not full-card approval.

roadmap.title: Opponent decisions and visible automation audit
roadmap.scope: Audited opponent cast triggers, Shorikai draw/discard/Pilot, hidden-hand-safe skipped count, deterministic decisions and stack pauses
roadmap.acceptance: Same actions and costs for both players, opponent trace, explicit manual stopping and tested no-fake-outcome behaviour

roadmap.title: Generic event queue and replacement-effect stages
roadmap.scope: Cast, ETB, death, graveyard movement and token replacement; Doubling Season, Elspeth Storm Slayer, Divine Visitation
roadmap.acceptance: Replacement modifies event before token entry, simultaneous triggers ordered with APNAP and choices recorded

roadmap.title: Token-spell X and multimode support
roadmap.scope: Secure the Wastes, White Sun’s Twilight, Martial Coup, Grand Crescendo, Saw in Half and copy tokens
roadmap.acceptance: Pay X, resolve stack, create correct token counts, copy characteristics and enter triggers; no invented resolution

roadmap.title: Card selection and draw/draw-discard decisions
roadmap.scope: Brainstorm, Ponder, Preordain, Greater Good, Shorikai, Sram, Whirlwind; opponent reproducible heuristic vs player choice
roadmap.acceptance: Interactive player hand/library/selection choices and reproducible AI choices without hidden info leakage

roadmap.title: Room door state and unlock action
roadmap.scope: Victor: Defiled Crypt/Cadaver Lab, Grand Entryway/Elegant Rotunda, Surgical Suite/Hospital Room, Victor eerie thresholds
roadmap.acceptance: Two independent unlocked-door flags, cast-one-door, pay-to-unlock special action, fully-unlocked transition fires once

roadmap.title: Double-faced, adventure and prepare semantics
roadmap.scope: Esika/Prismatic Bridge, Ral, Urabrask, Matzalantli, Fell the Profane, Glasswing Grace, Disciple of Freyalise, Murderous Rider, Grave Researcher/Reanimate
roadmap.acceptance: Choose legal casting face, transform state independent of type, correct zones and mana costs and no free alternate casting

roadmap.title: Planeswalker counters and repeated activation exceptions
roadmap.scope: Proliferate; Chain Veil, Oath of Teferi, Doubling Season, Ichormoon Gauntlet, lethal damage/combat and loyalty ability effects
roadmap.acceptance: Loyalty distinct from +1/+1, activated effects resolve, multiple legal activations only when card allows, no false manual auto-resolution

roadmap.title: Recursion, copies and ETB/death loops
roadmap.scope: Muldrotha, Scarab God 4/4 Zombie copy, Necroduality, Mirrorworks, Deadeye Navigator, Insidious Roots
roadmap.acceptance: Event-linked permanents retain ownership/token characteristics and obey graveyard/exile restrictions

roadmap.title: Vehicles, crew, attachment and equipment effects
roadmap.scope: Shorikai Vehicle, Sai tokens, Sram draw, Karn artifact kit, T’Challa equipment attachments
roadmap.acceptance: Creature stats and tapping during crew, equipment costs/timing, effects only when attached

roadmap.title: Card-level evidence gates and reproducible 9-deck simulator diagnostics
roadmap.scope: 644 Scryfall card records, 9x100 decks, 767 named entries; audited coverage classifications not equivalent to fidelity
roadmap.acceptance: Each card referenced by deck, source, layout, flags, effect support stage and verified test evidence; failed gates never labelled live
